subject: Gold Skulltula #073 (Master Quest)
text: In the northernmost room of the Ice Cavern in Master Quest, play the Song of Time near the red ice to make blue blocks appear, melt the red ice with blue fire, and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
In the northern-most room, get as near to the red ice as possible
 and Navi will fly to a location. Play the Song of Time to make a blue block
 appear. Hop onto it, play the Song of Time again (if you're not right by the
 red ice) to make another blue block appear. Hop on that, then drop some blue
 fire onto the ice. Hookshot the Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #074
text: In the Ice Cavern, melt the red ice wall on the east side of the ice blade room with blue fire and proceed to the next room to find the Gold Skulltula in the corner where the Piece of Heart is located.

evidence.quote:
Grab some blue fire from the torch at the end of the Cavern, and
 head back to the ice blade room. Melt the red ice wall on the east side and
 follow the hall to another room. The Gold Skulltula is in the corner where the
 Piece of Heart is.

subject: Gold Skulltula #074 (Master Quest)
text: In the westernmost icy-floored room of the Ice Cavern in Master Quest, play the Scarecrow's Song to summon Pierre to an alcove and Hookshot up to obtain the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
In the western-most room, (the icy-floored room with two White 
 Wolfos and two Ice Keese) there is an alcove that Navi will fly up to. Play
 your Scarecrow's Song to make Pierre appear. Hookshot up there to find this
 Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #075
text: In the Ice Cavern, melt the west red ice wall in the ice blade room to find the Gold Skulltula on the left in the next room.

evidence.quote:
Melt the west red ice wall in the ice blade room, and at the next
 room, the Gold Skulltula will be on your left.

subject: Gold Skulltula #075 (Master Quest)
text: In the Ice Cavern in Master Quest, hit the crystal switch hidden in the entrance alcove of the westernmost room to remove ice blocks leading to the red ice above and reach the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
In the same room as Skulltula #074 (Master Quest), there's a 
 crystal switch hidden in the alcove where you first enter the room. Hit it to
 make the ice blocks leading to the red ice above disappear. Go there to find a
 Gold Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #076
text: In Zora's Domain during the future at nighttime, look out and to the left from where the Diving Game used to be and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Head to the Diving Game, (or at least where it used to be) and look
 out and to the left. Hookshot the Gold Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #077
text: In Lake Hylia during the future, sink to the bottom of the Lakeside Laboratory pool with Iron Boots, roll into the crate to reveal the Gold Skulltula, and retrieve it using the Hookshot.

evidence.quote:
Sink to the bottom of the Lakeside Laboratory pool and roll into
 the crate to reveal this Skulltula. Use the only weapon you can use (Hookshot)
 to get it.

subject: Gold Skulltula #078
text: In the Water Temple, head down the south hall after draining the water, bomb the cracked floor, step on the switch to raise a pillar, Hookshot to the pillar, defeat the Tektites, and hit the crystal switch with an Advanced Spin Slash to open the gate hiding the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Head down the south hall at the bottom of the main room after
 draining the water, bomb the cracked floor at the end, and rise to the surface
 at the end of the hall. Step on the switch to raise the water slightly, also
 raising a pillar. Hookshot to the pillar, kill the Tektites, and use the
 Advanced Spin Slash to open the crystal switch to open the gate. The Skulltula
 is behind the gate.

subject: Gold Skulltula #078 (Master Quest)
text: In the Water Temple in Master Quest, raise the water level to the second floor, open the main room alcove gate via its switch, proceed through the hall, and use Din's Fire to kill the Gold Skulltula and light the torch to open the gate.

evidence.quote:
After getting the water level to as high as the second floor, find
 the alcove with a switch in the main room. Step on it to open the gate. Head 
 through the hall to find another gate. Use Din's Fire to kill both the Gold 
 Skulltula and light the torch, which opens the gate. Grab the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #079
text: In the Water Temple underground river past the Shadow Link room, follow the river using the Iron Boots to find the Gold Skulltula near the second whirlpool.

evidence.quote:
In the underground river past the Shadow Link room, use the Iron 
 Boots, following the river and avoiding the whirlpools. Near the second 
 whirlpool is this Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #079 (Master Quest)
text: In the Water Temple in Master Quest, place a small box on the blue switch in the main room, hit the crystal switch inside the room by breaking crates, Longshot to the upper room, and break crates to reveal the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
After getting the water level to as high as the second floor, go to
 the east side of the main room to see a hall. Go through that and Hookshot up
 to find a room filled with crates, pots, and small boxes. Carry a small box
 back to the main room, jump across, and take it to the other side where a blue
 switch is. Keep the switch down by placing the box on it, and enter the door.
 In this room, break crates until you find a crystal switch. Hit it, and then
 Longshot to the upper room from here. Break crates here to find this 
 Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #080
text: In the Water Temple, raise the water level to its highest, enter the west door from the main room into the room with moving platforms against a waterfall, and use the Longshot to retrieve the Gold Skulltula on the far right wall.

evidence.quote:
Raise the water level to it highest, then enter the west door from
 the main room to enter a room with moving platforms against a waterfall. Use
 the Longshot to get this Skulltula far on the right wall.

subject: Gold Skulltula #080 (Master Quest)
text: In the Water Temple in Master Quest, proceed to the underground river room after defeating Dark Link and Longshot past the second whirlpool to find and collect the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
After defeating Dark Link, head into the underground river room
 that's up next. Note the whirlpool at the beginning, and start Longshotting
 along the river until you just pass the second whirlpool. Look around to find
 a Gold Skulltula. Longshot it and its token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #081
text: In the Water Temple, after obtaining the Longshot and lowering the water level with Zelda's Lullaby, enter the central structure from the main room, Longshot to the platform, and hit the Gold Skulltula located on the ceiling.

evidence.quote:
After getting the Longshot, head to the room where you met Ruto,
 float to the top, and play Zelda's Lullaby to lower the water level. Head back
 to the main room, enter the central structure, and Longshot to the platform up
 there. The Gold Skulltula is on the ceiling, and can easily be reached with
 the Longshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula #081 (Master Quest)
text: In the Water Temple in Master Quest, navigate past the northern passage on the 1st floor using Pierre, raise geysers via a crystal switch, light torches with Din's Fire, defeat all the Dodongos in the next room, and break one of the crates to uncover the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
After getting the Boss Key, sink to the 1st floor in the main room
 and go through the northern passage. At its end, Longshot up, then across the
 water over spikes, and enter the door. In the next room, play your Scarecrow's
 Song near the left edge up here and Longshot to Pierre. Enter the door in the
 alcove up here, then drop down in the next room. Stand on the second geyser
 and shoot the crystal switch to raise the geysers. Use Din's Fire to light all
 but one torch, then go over to that side and light that torch with Din's Fire
 to open the door. In this next room, kill all the Dodongos (bombing them and
 sniping them with arrows from above helps) including the one in the hall to
 open the door ahead. Longshot to it and enter it. Break one of the crates here
 to find a Gold Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #082
text: In the Water Temple, the Gold Skulltula is located in the small area with rolling boulders past the northernmost room of the First Floor.

evidence.quote:
In the room after the northern-most room of the First Floor, you'll
 see a small area with boulders rolling by. This Gold Skulltula is nearby.

subject: Gold Skulltula #082 (Master Quest)
text: In the Water Temple in Master Quest, sink to the bottom of the main room after getting Fire Arrows, light three torches in the southern hall with Fire Arrows, Longshot to Pierre, defeat the Stalfos, and check the ceiling of the small room for the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
After getting the Fire Arrows, return to the temple and sink to the
 bottom of the main room. Go through the southern hall and surface at the end.
 Find the three torches and shoot them with Fire Arrows to light them, then
 play your Scarecrow's Song. Longshot to Pierre, kill the Stalfos, then look at
 the ceiling in the small room for this Skulltula.
